metric.name: mean_score
metric.description: Mean fraction of the LP-relaxation bound achieved across 40 held-out knapsack instances. Ranges 0–1; the naive baseline scores around 0.5.

gates.reason: Every answer must respect the capacity limit. A solver that overfills scores well on value and is useless.
A solution that throws on any instance is not a solution.

holdout.description: 40 instances in harness/holdout/, generated from a different seed than the 40 training instances. The solution may read harness/train/ and never harness/holdout/.
